scenes.title: OR
scenes.narration: OR combines conditions so a row qualifies if at least one of them is true.

scenes.title: How OR works
bullets: Broadens results as you add more
Often paired with parentheses for clarity
scenes.narration: OR keeps a row when at least one of its conditions is true, unlike AND which requires them all. Each extra OR condition widens the result rather than narrowing it. Wrapping OR groups in parentheses keeps the logic unambiguous when mixed with AND.

scenes.title: Either condition with OR
scenes.narration: This query returns a customer if their city is either London or Paris. Only one of the two conditions needs to be true for the row to qualify. The result gathers customers from both cities into a single list.

scenes.heading: AND vs OR
scenes.narration: AND requires every condition to hold, so it filters results down tightly. OR only needs one condition to be true, so it opens the results up. Mixing them without parentheses can change the meaning, so group carefully.

scenes.text: OR broadens your filter, matching rows that satisfy any of the listed conditions.
scenes.narration: Reach for OR when any one of several conditions should qualify a row, and use parentheses to keep mixed logic clear.
